name: Tropius
flavour_text: It lives in tropical jungles. The bunch of fruit around its neck is delicious. The fruit grows twice a year.

name: Leafeon
flavour_text: When you see Leafeon asleep in a patch of sunshine, you’ll know it is using photosynthesis to produce clean air.

name: Bounsweet
flavour_text: Its sweat is sweet, like syrup made from boiled-down fruit. Because of this, Bounsweet was highly valued in the past, when sweeteners were scarce.

name: Steenee
flavour_text: Steenee spreads a sweet scent that makes others feel invigorated. This same scent is popular for antiperspirants.

name: Tsareena
flavour_text: This Pokémon is proud and aggressive. However, it is said that a Tsareena will instantly become calm if someone touches the crown on its calyx.

name: Applin
flavour_text: It grows by eating the flesh of an apple. Applin uses its own body fluid to strengthen the apple’s skin and prevent it from rotting.

name: Appletun
flavour_text: It feeds mainly on sweet apples. It will also eat small bug Pokémon that are attracted by its sweet nectar.

name: Flareon
flavour_text: Inhaled air is carried to its flame sac, heated, and exhaled as fire that reaches over 3,000 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Torkoal
flavour_text: It burns coal inside its shell for energy. It blows out black soot if it is endangered.

name: Litten
flavour_text: If you try too hard to get close to it, it won’t open up to you. Even if you do grow close, giving it too much affection is still a no-no.

name: Torracat
flavour_text: Torracat will let its Trainer coddle it once they’ve grown close, but it’s a powerful, sharp-clawed Pokémon, so its Trainer gets covered in scratches.

name: Incineroar
flavour_text: Although it’s rough mannered and egotistical, it finds beating down unworthy opponents boring. It gets motivated for stronger opponents.

name: Salandit
flavour_text: It taunts its prey and lures them into narrow, rocky areas where it then sprays them with toxic gas to make them dizzy and take them down.

name: Salazzle
flavour_text: Salazzle makes its opponents light-headed with poisonous gas, then captivates them with alluring movements to turn them into loyal servants.

name: Vaporeon
flavour_text: It lives close to water. Its long tail is ridged with a fin, which is often mistaken for a mermaid’s.

name: Glaceon
flavour_text: It can control its body temperature at will. This enables it to freeze the moisture in the atmosphere, creating flurries of diamond dust.

name: Vanillite
flavour_text: Unable to survive in hot areas, it makes itself comfortable by breathing out air cold enough to cause snow. It burrows into the snow to sleep.

name: Vanillish
flavour_text: By drinking pure water, it grows its icy body. This Pokémon can be hard to find on days with warm, sunny weather.

name: Vanilluxe
flavour_text: When its anger reaches a breaking point, this Pokémon unleashes a fierce blizzard that freezes every creature around it, be they friend or foe.

name: Alomomola
flavour_text: It gently holds injured and weak Pokémon in its fins. Its special membrane heals their wounds.

name: Popplio
flavour_text: The balloons it inflates with its nose grow larger and larger as it practices day by day.

name: Brionne
flavour_text: It gets excited when it sees a dance it doesn’t know. This hard worker practices diligently until it can learn that dance.

name: Jolteon
flavour_text: It concentrates the weak electric charges emitted by its cells and launches wicked lightning bolts.

name: Joltik
flavour_text: Joltik can be found clinging to other Pokémon. It’s soaking up static electricity because it can’t produce a charge on its own.

name: Galvantula
flavour_text: It launches electrified fur from its abdomen as its means of attack. Opponents hit by the fur could be in for three full days and nights of paralysis.

name: Espeon
flavour_text: The tip of its forked tail quivers when it is predicting its opponent’s next move.

name: Woobat
flavour_text: While inside a cave, if you look up and see lots of heart-shaped marks lining the walls, it’s evidence that Woobat live there.

name: Swoobat
flavour_text: Emitting powerful sound waves tires it out. Afterward, it won’t be able to fly for a little while.

name: Swirlix
flavour_text: It eats its own weight in sugar every day. If it doesn’t get enough sugar, it becomes incredibly grumpy.

name: Slurpuff
flavour_text: By taking in a person’s scent, it can sniff out their mental and physical condition. It’s hoped that this skill will have many medical applications.

name: Sylveon
flavour_text: This Pokémon uses its ribbonlike feelers to send a soothing aura into its opponents, erasing their hostility.

name: Mimikyu
flavour_text: This Pokémon lives in dark places untouched by sunlight. When it appears before humans, it hides itself under a cloth that resembles a Pikachu.

name: Milcery
flavour_text: This Pokémon was born from sweet-smelling particles in the air. Its body is made of cream.

name: Alcremie
flavour_text: When it trusts a Trainer, it will treat them to berries it’s decorated with cream.

name: Barboach
flavour_text: Its two whiskers provide a sensitive radar. Even in muddy waters, it can detect its prey’s location.

name: Whiscash
flavour_text: It is extremely protective of its territory. If any foe approaches, it attacks using vicious tremors.

name: Mienfoo
flavour_text: In one minute, a well-trained Mienfoo can chop with its arms more than 100 times.

name: Mienshao
flavour_text: When Mienshao comes across a truly challenging opponent, it will lighten itself by biting off the fur on its arms.

name: Carbink
flavour_text: When beset by attackers, Carbink wipes them all out by firing high-energy beams from the gems embedded in its body.

name: Umbreon
flavour_text: When exposed to the moon’s aura, the rings on its body glow faintly and it gains a mysterious power.

name: Sableye
flavour_text: Materials from gems it has eaten float to the surface of its body and can form an infinite number of patterns among individuals.

name: Purrloin
flavour_text: Opponents that get drawn in by its adorable behavior come away with stinging scratches from its claws and stinging pride from its laughter.

name: Liepard
flavour_text: Don’t be fooled by its gorgeous fur and elegant figure. This is a moody and vicious Pokémon.

name: Mawile
flavour_text: It uses its docile-looking face to lull foes into complacency, then bites with its huge, relentless jaws.

name: Togedemaru
flavour_text: With the long hairs on its back, this Pokémon takes in electricity from other electric Pokémon. It stores what it absorbs in an electric sac.

name: Meltan
flavour_text: It dissolves and eats metal. Circulating liquid metal within its body is how it generates energy.

name: Melmetal
flavour_text: At the end of its life-span, Melmetal will rust and fall apart. The small shards left behind will eventually be reborn as Meltan.

name: Dratini
flavour_text: It sheds many layers of skin as it grows larger. During this process, it is protected by a rapid waterfall.

name: Dragonair
flavour_text: They say that if it emits an aura from its whole body, the weather will begin to change instantly.

name: Drampa
flavour_text: The mountains it calls home are nearly two miles in height. On rare occasions, it descends to play with the children living in the towns below.

name: Eevee
flavour_text: Its ability to evolve into many forms allows it to adapt smoothly and perfectly to any environment.

name: Aipom
flavour_text: As it did more and more with its tail, its hands became clumsy. It makes its nest high in the treetops.

name: Ambipom
flavour_text: It uses its tails for everything. If it wraps both of its tails around you and gives you a squeeze, that’s proof it really likes you.

name: Chatot
flavour_text: It mimics the cries of other Pokémon to trick them into thinking it’s one of them. This way they won’t attack it.

name: Audino
flavour_text: This Pokémon has a kind heart. By touching with its feelers, Audino can gauge other creatures’ feelings and physical conditions.

name: Minccino
flavour_text: The way it brushes away grime with its tail can be helpful when cleaning. But its focus on spotlessness can make cleaning more of a hassle.

name: Cinccino
flavour_text: Its body secretes oil that this Pokémon spreads over its nest as a coating to protect it from dust. Cinccino won’t tolerate even a speck of the stuff.

name: Skwovet
flavour_text: It stores berries in its cheeks. When there are no berries to be found, Skwovet will stuff pebbles into its cheeks to stave off its cravings.

name: Greedent
flavour_text: This Pokémon makes off with heaps of fallen berries by wrapping them in its tail, which is roughly twice the length of its body.

name: Leafeon
flavour_text: When you see Leafeon asleep in a patch of sunshine, you’ll know it is using photosynthesis to produce clean air.

name: Flareon
flavour_text: Inhaled air is carried to its flame sac, heated, and exhaled as fire that reaches over 3,000 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Vaporeon
flavour_text: It lives close to water. Its long tail is ridged with a fin, which is often mistaken for a mermaid’s.

name: Glaceon
flavour_text: It can control its body temperature at will. This enables it to freeze the moisture in the atmosphere, creating flurries of diamond dust.

name: Jolteon
flavour_text: It concentrates the weak electric charges emitted by its cells and launches wicked lightning bolts.

name: Espeon
flavour_text: The tip of its forked tail quivers when it is predicting its opponent’s next move.

name: Sylveon
flavour_text: This Pokémon uses its ribbonlike feelers to send a soothing aura into its opponents, erasing their hostility.

name: Umbreon
flavour_text: When exposed to the moon’s aura, the rings on its body glow faintly and it gains a mysterious power.

name: Eevee
flavour_text: Its ability to evolve into many forms allows it to adapt smoothly and perfectly to any environment.

name: Pinsir
flavour_text: These Pokémon judge one another based on pincers. Thicker, more impressive pincers make for more popularity with the opposite gender.

name: Lapras
flavour_text: A smart and kindhearted Pokémon, it glides across the surface of the sea while its beautiful song echoes around it.

name: Voltorb
flavour_text: It rolls to move. If the ground is uneven, a sudden jolt from hitting a bump can cause it to explode.

name: Electrode
flavour_text: The more energy it charges up, the faster it gets. But this also makes it more likely to explode.

name: Ralts
flavour_text: The horns on its head provide a strong power that enables it to sense people’s emotions.

name: Kirlia
flavour_text: It has a psychic power that enables it to distort the space around it and see into the future.

name: Gardevoir
flavour_text: To protect its Trainer, it will expend all its psychic power to create a small black hole.

name: Ekans
flavour_text: By dislocating its jaw, it can swallow prey larger than itself. After a meal, it curls up and rests.

name: Arbok
flavour_text: The latest research has determined that there are over 20 possible arrangements of the patterns on its stomach.

name: Farfetch'd
flavour_text: The stalk this Pokémon carries in its wings serves as a sword to cut down opponents. In a dire situation, the stalk can also serve as food.
